logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.

events.label: GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant)
events.content: "Look at him."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.

events.label: GERALD (Scornful)
events.content: "A penniless nobody for a discarded bride."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.

events.label: CLARISSA (Gleeful, Condescending)
events.content: "How fitting."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.

events.label: CLARISSA (Taunting)
events.content: "You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.

events.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling)
events.content: "You don't even know me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.

events.label: JULIANA (Conflicted, Pained)
events.content: "You heard what they think I am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.

events.label: JULIANA (Searching)
events.content: "Why would you offer me your name?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Certain)
events.content: "Because I know what I see."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Hesitant)
events.content: "And what do you see?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Sincere)
events.content: "A woman who was betrayed."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Resolute)
events.content: "Not a woman who deserves to be discarded."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Bitter)
events.content: "You don't know what my family has done to me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn)
events.content: "I know they have made you stand alone."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Gentle)
events.content: "You don't have to stand alone now."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Dignified)
events.content: "If this is pity, take back your ring."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
events.content: "I will not become anyone's charity."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Earnest)
events.content: "It is not pity, Lady Juliana."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Deep, Absolute)
events.content: "It is a vow."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
events.content: "I don't know this man."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
events.content: "I don't know what waits beyond these doors."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
events.content: "But he looked at me when everyone else turned away."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.

events.label: JULIANA (Resolved)
events.content: "Then I accept."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.

events.label: THE PRIEST (Hesitant, Anxious)
events.content: "My- My Lady..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.

events.label: THE PRIEST (Tentative)
events.content: "Are you certain?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.

events.label: JULIANA (Unwavering)
events.content: "I am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.

events.label: THE PRIEST (Resigned, Solemn)
events.content: "Then... let us proceed."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Reassuring)
events.content: "You need not say anything you do not mean."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.

events.label: JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
events.content: "I truly mean it."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn)
events.content: "You have my protection."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Steadfast)
events.content: "You have my respect."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave)
events.content: "And you have my word."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.

events.label: THE PRIEST (Ceremonial)
events.content: "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.

events.label: THE PRIEST (Off-Screen, Booming)
events.content: "...husband and wife!"

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Dramatic musical chord swelling.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.

events.label: GERALD (Furious, Shouting)
events.content: "You have thrown yourself away!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

events.label: GERALD (Livid)
events.content: "For a penniless nobody!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.

events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)
events.content: "I would rather choose my own life..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm, Final)
events.content: "...than spend another moment begging for yours."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.

events.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting)
events.content: "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.

events.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous)
events.content: "You are disowned!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

events.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective)
events.content: "Come, Lady Juliana."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.
